newsitem.title: GERMANY: Metro down after lowers 97 sales forecast.
newsitem.headline: Metro down after lowers 97 sales forecast.

text.p: Shares in Swiss-controlled German retail giant Metro AG fell on Wednesday after the firm released a pessimistic sales forecast.
The stock fell 8.10 marks, or six percent, to 126.60 marks, while the whole DAX index of 30 leading shares was off 0.80 percent at 2,697.32. Earlier Metro shares touched a year-low at 126.50 marks.
The fall came after Metro said on Tuesday it expected no improvement in the consumer climate next year and would lower its medium-term sales forecasts accordingly.
The company also said it was holding its goal of pre-tax profits of 1.0-1.1 billion marks for this year despite continued weak consumer demand in the third quarter.
